item.title: Speculative decoding without a draft model
item.description: n-gram proposals verified in the same batched forward pass.
item.content:encoded:
The trick is that the proposals cost nothing: they come from an n-gram table built out of the prompt itself.

Verification happens in the batch you were already running.
